roleHints.TenantOwner: Full control of the tenant, on every farm. Only an owner can transfer ownership.
roleHints.TenantAdmin: Manages users, farms and settings across every farm in the tenant.
roleHints.BillingAdmin: Subscriptions and invoices only. No access to farm data.
roleHints.FarmManager: Runs the farms you choose below: blocks, plans, workers and alerts.
roleHints.Agronomist: Reviews and acts on recommendations and alerts for the farms you choose below.
roleHints.FieldOperator: Records work done in the field on the farms you choose below.
roleHints.Scout: Files scouting visits and observations on the farms you choose below.
roleHints.Viewer: Read-only access to the farms you choose below.

role.replaceNotice: Setting a role replaces the one this person holds now. Roles do not add up.
